about_the_game:
About the Game

About the Game

Oops! My King! is an innovative PvP strategy game that combines classic chess rules with a turn-based card game system. On boards ranging from 3x3 to 8x8, players deploy their pieces using the cards in their hands, place bets on each one, and then the battle begins!

In each round, you draw and place cards to form your own formation. There is no checkmate objective in the game — the sole goal is to eliminate all opposing pieces. Chess moves are valid, but freedom and variety are at the core of this game.

With the betting system, you can assign strategic value to each piece and earn extra rewards with surviving pieces.

Oops! My King! is a fast-paced, strategic challenge that appeals to both classic chess enthusiasts and card game lovers, offering a unique experience in every match!
